fact_saleorder.description: One row per customer order or cart (grain: order_id). Orders are keyed '{market}-{number}'. Includes carts and canceled orders, so filter order_state = 'complete' for real sales. Money columns are in the market's local currency.

order_id.description: Unique order identifier in the form '{market}-{number}', e.g. 'AU-100123'.

market.description: Country market the order was placed in: AU (Australia), SG (Singapore), US, UK, CA (Canada).

customer_id.description: The customer who placed the order. Links to dim_customer.

order_state.description: Lifecycle state: 'complete' (a real, paid order), 'canceled', or 'cart' (not yet purchased). Exclude 'cart' and 'canceled' for sales reporting.

created_at.description: When the order or cart was created. Use this for order-date analysis (monthly, weekly trends).

payment_completion_time.description: When payment completed. NULL for carts and canceled orders.

o2o_flag.description: 'Y' if this was an online-to-offline order (placed online, handled via a showroom). 'N' otherwise. CA has no offline store, so it is always 'N'.

goods_amount.description: Value of the goods after line-level discounts, before shipping and tax.

promo_amount.description: Total promotional discount applied to the order across all lines.

shipping_amount.description: Shipping fee charged. Zero for carts and for orders with goods_amount over 1500.

tax_amount.description: Tax charged (GST/VAT/sales tax depending on market). Zero for carts.

order_amount.description: Total the customer pays: goods_amount + shipping_amount + tax_amount.

reporting_sales.description: Sales figure used for reporting: goods_amount + shipping_amount (excludes tax). Use this, not order_amount, for revenue.

fact_saleorderline.description: One row per product line within an order (grain: line_id). Join to fact_saleorder on order_id and to dim_product on product_id. Gift-with-purchase lines are included and flagged with is_gwp.

order_id.description: The order this line belongs to.

product_id.description: The product sold. Links to dim_product.

quantity.description: Units of the product on this line.

list_price.description: Undiscounted price of ONE unit at the time of sale.

promo_amount.description: Discount applied to this whole line (quantity x list_price x discount rate).

discounted_amount.description: Line value AFTER discount: quantity x list_price - promo_amount. This is the line's sales value; it is NOT the discount.

is_gwp.description: True for gift-with-purchase lines: a free item added by a promotion. Exclude when counting items the customer bought.

foc_flag.description: 'Y' if the line was free of charge (discounted_amount = 0), 'N' otherwise.

fact_saleorder_shipment.description: One row per shipment of a completed order (grain: shipment_id). Carts and canceled orders have no shipment. Join to fact_saleorder on order_id.

service_type.description: Delivery service: 'Standard' (kerbside), 'Room of Choice', or 'White Glove' (assembly and packaging removal).

shipped_at.description: When the shipment left the warehouse. NULL while state = 'ready'.

delivered_at.description: When the shipment was delivered. NULL unless state = 'delivered'. Delivery lead time = delivered_at - shipped_at.

dim_customer.description: One row per customer (grain: customer_id). Join from fact_saleorder.customer_id.

market.description: The customer's home market: AU, SG, US, UK, or CA.

customer_type.description: 'B2C' for consumers, 'B2B' for business or trade customers.

acquisition_channel.description: How the customer was first acquired: organic, paid_search, social, referral, email, or showroom.

dim_product.description: One row per product (grain: product_id). Join from fact_saleorderline.product_id. Hierarchy: category > subcategory > product.

category.description: Top-level furniture category: Living, Bedroom, Dining, Storage, Outdoor, or Decor.

subcategory.description: Finer product grouping within a category, e.g. Sofas, Beds, Dining Tables.

collection.description: Design collection the product belongs to, e.g. Mellow, Aria, Nova.

list_price.description: Current undiscounted list price of one unit.

glossary.definition: Revenue measured by reporting_sales on fact_saleorder (goods plus shipping, excluding tax), counting only orders with order_state = 'complete'.
Average order value: average reporting_sales across complete orders.
An order with order_state = 'cart': created but not purchased. Carts carry no shipping or tax and are not sales.
Gift with purchase: a free item added by a promotion. Lines flagged is_gwp = true in fact_saleorderline.
Free of charge. A line with foc_flag = 'Y' (discounted_amount = 0).
Online-to-offline: an order placed online but handled through a showroom (o2o_flag = 'Y').
Business or trade customer (customer_type = 'B2B'). Everything else is B2C.
Premium delivery service including assembly and packaging removal (service_type = 'White Glove').
Days between shipped_at and delivered_at on fact_saleorder_shipment, for delivered shipments.
